exposure: transfer of in vivo conceived, genetically screened euploid blastocysts obtained by uterine lavage
cohort: Eight infertile women who underwent nine embryo transfer procedures with 14 in vivo conceived, genetically screened human euploid blastocysts obtained by uterine lavage.
finding: The study reported a blastocyst implantation rate of 36% and a live birth rate of 44%, resulting in five live infants from four pregnancies after transferring in vivo conceived, genetically screened euploid blastocysts obtained by uterine lavage.
